cv.name: Pham Bui Nam Phuong
cv.location: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam
cv.summary: Software Engineer with over 2 years of practical experience architecting and optimizing full-stack applications using the **.NET** and **Node.js** ecosystems. Strong foundational expertise in **Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)**, **Design Patterns**, and Agile development, with a proven track record of resolving critical performance bottlenecks and automating complex workflows in high-traffic enterprise environments.
cv.objective: A dedicated Software Engineer aiming to leverage advanced knowledge of **C#**, **.NET Framework**, and **Object-Oriented Design** to architect scalable solutions at MiTek. Driven to collaborate within an Agile environment, refactor legacy architectures, and deliver high-performance software that directly accelerates client breakthroughs in the building solutions industry.

experiences.location: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam

bullets.text: **Project: Altus Entertainment** - A large-scale CRM ecosystem managing booking and contracts for over **20,000 artists** in the US.

Architected a scalable event logging module utilizing the **State pattern** in **C# / .NET Core** and **RabbitMQ**, resolving tracking instability and ensuring **zero-data-loss** during peak operational loads.

Engineered an automated content generation system via **FastAPI** and **Node.js**, employing **Registry and Factory patterns** for robust session management, which accelerated article creation from **5 hours to under 1 hour**.
Refactored a monolithic **Angular** frontend into multiple lazy-loaded modules, systematically addressing structural bottlenecks to reduce bundle size and client-side rendering latency.
Optimized Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) data fetching via progressive permission resolution in **Nebular UI**, successfully slashing user login wait time by **90%**.
Collaborated actively within an **Agile/Scrum** environment using **Jira** and **Bitbucket**, engaging in sprint planning and retrospectives to ensure continuous delivery of software features.

experiences.location: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam

bullets.text: **Project: NEEC Platform** - Core architecture migration and CMS development for an international consulting agency.
Spearheaded the architectural migration of a legacy WordPress site to a responsive **Vue 3** and **Node.js** application, overcoming scalability limitations of the old system.
Designed and deployed automated CI/CD pipelines via **GitHub Actions**, streamlining the release cycle to consistently achieve **2 to 3 stable deployments per week**.
Built a custom CMS using **Prisma ORM** and **Nuxt UI**, eliminating the client's dependency on developers by enabling independent administration of dynamic forms and content.
Graduation Thesis: A complex logistics backend designed to automate priority dispatching.
Engineered and securely deployed **4 independent microservices** via **Docker** within a tight **2-month** timeframe, utilizing **Node.js**, **MySQL**, and **Nginx**.
Implemented map data tuning and the **Dijkstra algorithm** (via OpenStreetMap) to compute highly optimized routing paths, significantly reducing average delivery transit times.

Developed core application logic utilizing **C/C++**, rigorously applying advanced data structures including **B-Trees**, **Linked Lists**, and **Arrays** to maximize data retrieval and memory efficiency.
Designed the graphical user interface using the **Raylib** framework to provide a seamless scheduling experience.

coverLetter.openingParagraph: I am writing to express my strong interest in the **Software Engineer** position at MiTek. With over two years of practical experience across the full software development lifecycle and a deep commitment to engineering excellence, I am eager to apply my robust expertise in **C#**, **.NET**, and **Object-Oriented Design** to help MiTek deliver continuous breakthroughs in building solutions.
bodyParagraphs: In my current role at PRIMAS CO. LTD, I serve as a primary technical contributor for Altus Entertainment, a CRM ecosystem managing over <u>20,000 artists</u>. To meet strict performance and reliability demands, I applied **Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)** and the **State pattern** in **C# / .NET Core** to architect a fault-tolerant event logging module using RabbitMQ. I actively refactored monolithic frontend architectures and aggressively optimized authorization flows, slashing user login latency by **90%**. Furthermore, I utilized **Registry and Factory patterns** within a Node.js automation microservice, drastically reducing content generation time from **5 hours to under 1 hour**.

My engineering approach aligns seamlessly with MiTek’s requirement for quality assurance and continuous workflow optimization. At Algorit Lab, I designed GitHub Actions pipelines that enabled **2 to 3 stable production deployments per week**. Working in rigorous **Agile/Scrum** environments using Jira, I consistently participated in sprint planning and retrospectives to ensure quality delivery. Additionally, my strong academic and project foundation in **C/C++** and advanced data structures (such as B-Trees) equips me with a deep understanding of memory management, which I am eager to bring to your cross-functional engineering teams.
coverLetter.closingParagraph: I am deeply inspired by MiTek’s 60-year history of global innovation and its supportive, inclusive engineering environment. I am confident that my proactive problem-solving mindset and technical rigor will make an immediate and positive impact on your Software Center. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background aligns with your strategic goals in an interview.
